purpose: Evidence-bounded exterior prototype; not a complete structural reconstruction or current visitor route.

frameExpectation.note: Inherited OSM roof-bbox anchor; not a surveyed column-grid origin.

surveyDatum.note: Floor world Y retains inherited model fit; 0.12m base offset is separately provisional, never a measured terrace elevation.

mainBody.perimeterStatus: SOURCE_DERIVED: perimeter nodes on measured grid; not all 24 Cartesian intersections

interiorGoldenColumns.source: S1 describes four remaining interior golden pillars; precise node mapping not transcribed. Exterior-only model omits these instead of guessing.

northWall.source: S1 Fig2 and S2 historical plan show continuous north-wall hatching at plan-cut height; not a statement of today's door status.

enclosureApproximation.note: Plain north/side enclosure and simplified front joinery. Upper frieze is an exterior skin, not an invented complete golden-column frame.

upperColumnHeadGrid.source: S1 p49 Table3, 2013 indirect scan-derived means; sampling and occlusion limitations retained. Not roof-board extents.

measuredLevels.source: S1 p56 Table8 measured column; all relative to column-base upper face

roofBoard.note: Idealized rectangular wood board, not measured tile plateau or upper column-head grid.

cutRafterProfile.source: S1 Figs7/8 black-grey cut structural lines, not outer ornament
cutRafterProfile.note: Conservative drawing-reading allowances, not statistical confidence or a contemporary error bound. Lower inner chosen at midpoint of6.8–7.0m drawing range.

roofSkinApproximation.note: Curved low-detail sealed tile skin, shallow crowned cover, rectangular perimeter ridge and rotational finial are explicit approximations. No exact ornament or surveyed highest point claimed.

plan.source: S1 Figs2/6; Fig6 label 抱厦構架仰視平面; corroborated historical five-bay elevation S2
plan.note: Front axes provisionally align with main five-bay foot grid. Drawings may share historical base; not independent modern surveys.

heights.note: Low annex massing fit to photograph/historical elevation; no measured rebuilt annex height.

skin.note: Three visible sloped surfaces with a rear high edge joining main south wall; hidden joint simplified, exact roof-type name withheld. Closed lattice preview panels do not assert current door status.

southAnnex.periodLimit: Rebuilding documented2004–2008; dimensions of completed modern annex not verified.

terraceGuide.source: S1 Fig2 at about35.5px/m; railing/stair guides, not stone-base exterior

supportApproximation.note: Visible support body follows stepped railing guides, with0.18m stone beyond rail centers; no widened circulation. Stair tread/riser heights and support datum are model fits; no accepted terrace route. South axial composite omitted pending level evidence.

navigation.visitorPolicy: Model exterior viewpoint, not an official present-day visitor route. Side-door and open-portico evidence unresolved; no central north doorway is modeled.
